name: Winter Dream
source: During his winter vacation, Caron moves in with his uncle Daniel who owns a restaurant. While staying there, he meets three girls each of them having some kind of tragic past. No matter where he goes, he can't avoid running into one of them. First, there's Velda, who is extremely rude, then Gwen who happens to be somewhat shy, and finally Rose, who seems way too nice. As he gets to know these girls, Caron will learn about their pasts and their connection to him.
